name: Clive Neal
source:
A genius who's called "The Walking Royal Library".
He has a haughty attitude and refuses to give in to anyone, he always respects the rules. Sometimes despite the fact that he's a genius he messes up his words, but he doesn't personally take notice at all.

He's a high ranking member of the royal police "Vanalgand" that gets support from BANK.
He has a cool headed way of speaking, but his weak point is sweets.
